blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed dark-theme dashboard with a restrained single-blue (#4477AA) accent palette and real typographic hierarchy, but the color-usage scatter degrades into indistinct visual noise at the rendered panel size and network node labels overlap noticeably.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline on bar chart, scaleSqrt for both node and color-point size encoding, data-driven domains throughout (d3.extent/d3.max), and fixed hue/lightness axes are semantically correct; no dual-axis, no lie factor, no silent gaps — minor deduction for missing key functions in bar joins and the background bars holding full-dataset scale while foreground updates, though that is an intentional design choice.
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: Dirty-flag + RAF pattern correctly coalesces all brush events; only weakness is brush handlers capture x/y scales by closure with no resize handler to refresh them, making them stale if the viewport ever changes.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: Four crossfilter-linked views form a coherent exploration unit rather than independent charts, and the monochromatic network palette and label restraint (top 15 of 60 nodes labeled) keep density manageable, but the color scatter and 60-node force graph simultaneously visible push working memory near its limit for first-time users.
